title: Batangas drops letter 'h' from 'ala eh,' welcomes foreign visitors

blocks.text: Batangas Gov. Vilma Santos and Batangas City Mayor Marvey Mariño have explained the decision to drop the “h” from the familiar Batangueño expression “Ala Eh,” with the province’s flagship cultural celebration now renamed the Ala E! Festival, scheduled for Dec. 1-8.
